working_title: Statewise versus operator Bell causality in finite quantum sequential growth: exact separation and recovery at dimension two

scope.occurrence_identification: ON is certified for the declared artifacts; OFF is retained as a separate bounded domain where the SR2 witness reports it
scope.paper_center: statewise versus operator observability, exact separation, and minimal recovery

claims.statement: The frozen v0.3.7/v0.3.9 literal strong-GC/strong-MSR finite d=2 n<=4 ON baseline forces Q1,...,Q4 commutativity on its recorded denominator-open and 21 QQ charts plus S3 certificate; Q5 is not used.
claims.allowed_wording: Use as the strong/strong comparison theorem; do not claim broad priority, self-adjoint priority, or complete d=2 classification.

claims.statement: Fixed-vector GC plus reachable-state MSR admits an exact rational noncommutative d=2 witness in the frozen finite n<=4 presentation.
claims.allowed_wording: Call this an exact logical weak/weak separation and an off-reachable-sector witness; do not call it reachable-visible noncommutativity.

claims.statement: Six raw antichain CPOBC relations and source nonsingularity imply the three k=1 Eq. (120) identities without MSR, GC, Eq. (108), Eq. (112), or B-reduction.
claims.allowed_wording: State the free-word lemma as dimension-independent; d=2 enters only in the subsequent chart closure.

claims.statement: On P_sGC+rMSR intersect image(Phi_U), source-to-direct inclusion, localisation, Eq. (120), and exact d=2 chart certificates force Q1,...,Q4 commutativity.
claims.allowed_wording: Call this a proper reconstruction-slice theorem; do not extend it to the full 955 profile or to the image complement.

claims.statement: Evaluation injectivity on the declared residual family is necessary and sufficient for statewise-to-operator recovery; same-residual two-probe recovery and the non-scalar 2x2 centralizer endpoint are exact.
claims.allowed_wording: Present as conditional recovery lemmas; do not assert that the ordinary single-Omega profile supplies the probes.

nonclaims.wording: Do not write complete finite ON semantics lattice.
The current weak/weak witness has reachable span rank one and is not reachable-visible.
The bounded GF determinantal scout is not a QQ full unit/non-unit theorem.
OFF compiler, relation minimality, n>=5, d>=3, singular, and infinite-system claims remain downstream.
